eval_dimensions.name: Production-Recording Gate
eval_dimensions.description: The operator states the recording's provenance via AskUserQuestion before the first upload, and a production recording is never published

eval_dimensions.name: Single-Artifact Selection
eval_dimensions.description: Exactly one video per run is published, preferring the narrated take when a sibling -narrated.mp4 exists

eval_dimensions.name: Narration Defect Visibility
eval_dimensions.description: Unrendered captions and an install anchor are surfaced before publishing, never silently uploaded

eval_dimensions.name: Per-Destination Embed Forms
eval_dimensions.description: linear_markdown and github_markdown are used verbatim for their own destination and never interchanged or hand-rebuilt

eval_dimensions.name: Wrapper Delegation
eval_dimensions.description: gog and the YouTube API are reached only through scripts/upload-video.py, never as raw calls

eval_dimensions.name: Failure Visibility
eval_dimensions.description: A missing scope, wrong channel, or unconfigured account produces an actionable error on stdout naming the fix

evals.name: Provenance gate fires before the first upload
evals.description: A recording is handed over for publishing with no prior provenance statement in the session

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is called before any upload subcommand runs
The gate states why provenance matters rather than asking a bare yes/no
No upload invocation appears before the gate is answered

evals.name: A caller's review approval does not satisfy the provenance gate
evals.description: Invoked from Dev10x:qa-self after its Phase 4.4 Approve, which covers footage quality but not world-readability
evals.input: /Dev10x:yt-upload publish the approved qa-self walkthrough for GH-42

assertions.signal: The provenance gate still fires even though the caller already gated on footage quality

evals.name: The narrated take is published, not the silent sibling
evals.description: The run directory holds both qa-gh-42.mp4 and qa-gh-42-narrated.mp4

assertions.signal: Artifact choice goes through resolve-video rather than an ad-hoc glob or a guess
The narrated variant is the one passed to upload
Exactly one upload invocation runs — the silent sibling is not also published

evals.name: Unrendered captions are surfaced before publishing
evals.description: narration.json reports a non-empty unrendered list for the resolved take

assertions.signal: The unrendered captions are reported to the operator with their actual lines
The defect is stated before any upload runs, not after the URL is returned

evals.name: Each destination gets its own returned form
evals.description: The returned URLs are posted to both a Linear ticket and a GitHub PR
evals.input: /Dev10x:yt-upload publish the walkthrough and give me the ticket and PR markdown

assertions.signal: The bare watch URL from linear_markdown is what goes to Linear
The linked poster frame from github_markdown is what goes to GitHub
A YouTube poster is never used inside Linear, where it does not render

evals.name: Publishing always routes through the wrapper
evals.description: A video is uploaded end to end

assertions.signal: Every gog and API interaction goes through the wrapper script path
No bare gog token export appears in the transcript

evals.name: A grant without youtube.upload names the re-auth command
evals.description: The stored gog grant can read YouTube but not publish to it

assertions.signal: The error names the missing scope and the --extra-scopes re-auth form
The fix tells the operator to copy the existing service list first, so other grants are not dropped
The run stops rather than attempting an upload that cannot succeed

evals.name: No account resolves to an actionable error, not a default
evals.description: No --account flag, no env var, and no yt-upload.yaml entry covers this checkout

assertions.signal: The error names the pin command instead of inventing an account default

should_trigger: A video file needs to become a shareable link
A QA walkthrough recording should be posted to a ticket and a PR
A bug repro recording needs an embeddable URL
should_not_trigger: Capturing the walkthrough recording itself (use Dev10x:qa-self)
Converting or verifying evidence files (use qa-self's own scripts)
Publishing a full QA evidence set to a ticket and PR (use Dev10x:qa-publish)
